name: Senjutsu Youhei Shidan Brave Blade
original_name: 戦術傭兵師団ブレイブブレイド
source:
400 hundred years ago the continent was ruled by demon kings, but eventually he was slayed with the help of holy sword Brave Blade. Now hero who is mercenary captain acquires this blade. 
A girl requests help from a tyrant. Hero sets to investigate and on the way he discovers and frees girls who are possessed by evil dresses "R-Enhance". No remorse for the tyrant!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
400年前，这片大陆由魔王统治，但最终他在圣剑Brave Blade的帮助下被斩杀。如今，身为佣兵团长的主人公获得了这把剑。一个女孩向暴君求助。主人公前往调查，途中发现并解救了被邪恶服装“R-Enhance”附身的女孩们。对暴君绝不留情！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
